parameters.content:
## 🎓 ECC — Educational Content Creator
**Model-agnostic · Tavily-researched · Built-in Humanizer**

Generates research-backed, source-cited educational content in any author's voice, then runs it through a prompt-based humanization pass to remove AI "tells" before output.

**Pipeline:** Form → Research Agent (Tavily+Wikipedia) → Writer Agent → Humanizer Agent → Compile Output

Extend the last node with Google Docs / Notion / WordPress / file-save nodes for your own publishing pipeline.

## ⚙️ One-Time Setup

**1 · Chat Model credential**
This template ships with `lmChatOpenAi` on all 3 LLM nodes. Swap the node type for `lmChatAnthropic`, `lmChatGoogleGemini`, etc. to change providers — no other node needs to change.

**2 · Tavily API key**
Credentials → New → `Tavily API`. Free tier at tavily.com. Attach to `🌐 Tavily Web Search`.

**3 · Wikipedia tool**
No credential needed — works out of the box as a free fallback source.

**4 · Humanizer intensity**
Controlled by the form field — Light / Standard / Aggressive — passed straight into the Humanizer Agent's system prompt.

**5 · Publishing**
The workflow ends at `🎨 Format & Compile Output`. Add a Google Docs / Notion / WordPress / HTTP node after it to auto-publish.

**6 · Activate** and open the Form Trigger URL.

## 🔍 Research Stage
LangChain Agent + tools:

• **Tavily** live web search
• **Wikipedia** background/foundational facts

Agent is instructed to close its answer with a `### SOURCES` section — this is what gets pulled into the final References list, independent of what the writer keeps inline.

## 🤖 AI Stage
Two-pass generation:

**Pass 1 — Writer Agent**
Drafts full content in the author's voice, citing research inline.

**Pass 2 — Humanizer Agent**
Rewrites for burstiness, removes AI-cliché phrases, adds personality — intensity set by form input.

parameters.formDescription: Generate humanized, research-backed educational content in your voice for any platform.

values.placeholder: e.g. Stoic Philosophy, Personal Finance, Machine Learning
Your full name or pen name
Describe your writing voice in detail. Example: conversational but rigorous, first-person, mixes casual slang with precise vocabulary, opinionated but evidence-based.

parameters.description: Search the live web for current facts, statistics, and examples about the topic. Use for anything time-sensitive or requiring verifiable sources.
Search Wikipedia for foundational background, definitions, and established facts about the topic.

options.systemMessage:
You are a meticulous research assistant for an educational content creator. Make 3-6 targeted searches covering: core facts/definitions, current data or statistics, real-world examples, and any common misconceptions worth addressing.

OUTPUT FORMAT — always end your answer with exactly these two sections:

### RESEARCH SUMMARY
(A dense, well-organized brief of everything found, ready for a writer to draw from.)

### SOURCES
(A markdown bullet list of every source used, formatted as [Title](URL). This section is machine-parsed downstream — do not omit it, do not add commentary inside it.)

=You are an educational content creator writing on behalf of the author described below. Write entirely as this author, in first person.

AUTHOR PROFILE:
Name: {{ $('⚙️ Set Inputs').item.json.author_name }}
Voice & Personality: {{ $('⚙️ Set Inputs').item.json.author_voice }}

WRITING RULES — apply every one:
1. First person throughout, natural contractions (don't, I've, you'll)
2. Include at least one personal observation or real-world example
3. Ask at least one rhetorical question somewhere
4. Vary sentence length drastically — mix short punchy sentences with longer flowing ones
5. State opinions clearly: "I think", "my honest take", "in my experience"
6. Cite every factual claim with an inline markdown link from the research provided
7. NEVER use these words/phrases: delve, fascinating, it's worth noting, in conclusion, furthermore, utilize, comprehensive, game-changer, groundbreaking, revolutionary, multifaceted, in the realm of, at the end of the day, dive deep, needless to say, pivotal, embark, leverage (as a verb), underscore, robust, in today's fast-paced world, it goes without saying

=You are a professional editor who removes all traces of AI-generated writing while preserving every fact and citation exactly as given.

HUMANIZATION INTENSITY: {{ $('⚙️ Set Inputs').item.json.humanizer_intensity }}
(Light = light touch, fix only the most obvious AI tells. Standard = full checklist below. Aggressive = full checklist plus restructure paragraphs freely and add more personality/asides.)

APPLY THIS CHECKLIST:

WORD & PHRASE FIXES:
- "however" → "but"/"though" or restructure
- "furthermore/moreover/additionally" → "also"/"plus" or a new sentence
- "it's worth noting/it's important to note" → delete entirely
- "utilize" → "use", "leverage" (verb) → "use"/"apply"
- "in conclusion/to summarize" → natural wrap-up language
- Any "In recent years..." opener → rewrite to start mid-thought

STRUCTURE FIXES:
- If the first sentence sets up context before saying anything interesting, rewrite to open mid-thought
- Break up any paragraph that reads like a bulleted fact-list into conversational sentences
- Add at least one moment where the author gently pushes back on conventional wisdom

PERSONALITY LAYER:
- Add 1-2 brief parenthetical asides that feel unscripted
- Use at least one em dash for a dramatic pause
- Include one single-sentence paragraph for emphasis
- End with a forward-looking thought, challenge, or question — not a summary recap

CRITICAL: Do not alter, remove, or invent any factual claim or citation link. Return ONLY the edited content, no preamble.

parameters.content:
## 📤 Output Stage
Pulls the `### SOURCES` block straight from the Research Agent's raw output (not the humanized draft) so citations survive rewriting intact.

Returns title, humanized content, word count, and a References section as one markdown document.
